summary.key_theme: Palantir 發布了營收成長 96 % 的強勁財報並上調財測，但因股價先前漲幅過高導致「利多出盡」與市場對訂單積壓狀況的擔憂，引發獲利了結賣壓。

bullish.title: Palantir (PLTR) Stock Cools As Q3 Earnings Showcase Huge Margins
bullish.reason: 公司 Q3 營收突破 23 億美元，展現了極高的獲利能力與 AI 軟體需求，基本面表現極佳。

bullish.title: Palantir Q3 Earnings Call Highlights Sovereign AI Demand and Outlook
bullish.reason: 主權 AI 需求加速成長，且美國商業銷售與國防部署表現強勁，為長期成長提供明確動能。

bullish.title: PLTR Stock Gets Price Target Hikes After ‘Another Top-Line Blowout’
bullish.reason: 儘管股價波動，多家分析師仍因營收表現優異而上調目標價，顯示華爾街對其長期競爭力仍具信心。

bullish.title: Palantir Well Positioned to Benefit From AI Tailwinds Amid Accelerating Revenue Growth, Truist Says
bullish.reason: Truist 指出 Palantir 在 AI 浪潮中處於有利地位，營收成長加速證明其軟體在市場上的滲透率。

bullish.title: Apple To $350? Here Are 10 Top Analyst Forecasts For Tuesday
bullish.reason: 分析師在財報後持續給予正面評價並調整目標價，為股價提供支撐。

bullish.title: Palantir Technologies to Benefit From Sovereign AI Growth, Morgan Stanley Says
bullish.reason: 摩根士丹利強調主權 AI 的成長潛力，認為 Palantir 的業務動能將延續至 Q4。

bullish.title: Palantir Technologies' Revenue Growth Offsets Flat Backlog, UBS Says
bullish.reason: 瑞銀認為強勁的營收成長足以抵銷訂單積壓停滯的疑慮，肯定其營運效率。

bullish.title: PLTR Slides More Despite Strong Results And Forecast — Cathie Wood’s ARK Buys The Dip
bullish.reason: 知名投資人 Cathie Wood 在股價回調時加碼買進，顯示機構投資者對其長期價值的認可。

bearish.title: Why Palantir Technologies Stock Crashed Today — The data mining and AI specialist delivered record-setting results. It wasn't enough.
bearish.reason: 典型的「利多出盡」現象，由於股價先前已反映過高預期，即便財報亮眼仍無法滿足市場胃口。

bearish.title: Palantir's AI demand is accelerating, but its backlog tells a more complicated story
bearish.reason: 市場對訂單積壓（Backlog）成長停滯感到擔憂，質疑未來營收成長的持續性。

bearish.title: Palantir Growth Slows From Breakneck Pace
bearish.reason: 儘管財測優於預期，但成長速度放緩的跡象引發投資人對高估值的重新評估。

bearish.title: Palantir Shares Fall Over 5% Despite 96% Revenue Growth as Contract Momentum Raises Concerns
bearish.reason: 合約簽署動能的疑慮導致股價在盤前交易即出現顯著下跌。

bearish.title: Palantir Is 'Priced to Perfection,' but Sovereign AI Could Fuel Its Next Rally
bearish.reason: 市場觀點認為股價已「定價完美」，意味著若無超乎預期的驚喜，股價難以進一步上漲。

bearish.title: PLTR Beats on Q3 Earnings and Raises Guidance: Is the Stock a Buy?
bearish.reason: 報導指出營收成長的同時，成本上升的問題也開始受到市場關注。

bearish.title: Palantir earnings analysis: questions answered and next catalysts
bearish.reason: 分析指出財報雖好，但市場對後續催化劑的缺乏感到焦慮。

bearish.title: Palantir grew Q3 revenue by 96% — so why is its stock falling now?
bearish.reason: 探討股價與強勁財報背離的原因，強化了市場對獲利了結的心理預期。

neutral.title: Buy the Dip in Apple or Palantir Stock After Earnings?
neutral.reason: 將 Palantir 與 Apple 進行比較，討論財報後的投資策略，屬於中性市場分析。

neutral.title: US Stock Futures Trade Mixed Premarket As AAPL Margin Concerns Weigh On Tech
neutral.reason: 提及 Palantir 受到整體科技股盤前波動影響，非公司單一因素。

neutral.title: Stock Market Today: S&P 500, Nasdaq 100, Dow Jones Futures Mixed
neutral.reason: 大盤走勢震盪，Palantir 隨市場情緒波動，無特定公司消息。
